name: skylark_get_trip_date
intent: Find the date of a past SkyLark flight to a city
description: Opens My Trips in SkyLark Air, finds the past trip to the requested city, opens its details, and reads the flight date from the trip details screen.
patterns: When did I fly to a city
When was my flight to a city
What date was my trip to a city
When did I travel to a city

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: The destination city of the past trip to look up.

steps.intent: Open My Trips to access trip history
Scroll until the past trip to {{trip_city}} is visible
Tap the past trip to {{trip_city}} to open its details and read the flight date
